authority: implementation policy of the ERC-8421 Mempool Sidecar; not ERC-8421 text

rules.summary: A payer owes each pending tx's maximum gas cost; a sender owes the value of its top-level frames. Pending obligations must fit the account balance.

refs.section: Keyed nonces and recent roots > Mempool rules > Balances
refs.quote: Pending transactions never owe an account more than its balance. A payer owes each transaction's maximum gas cost, and a sender owes the `value` of its top-level frames.

Pending frame transactions never owe an account more than its balance: the sum of `frameTxObligations` (payer: max gas cost; sender: top-level frame value) over every pending entry plus this one must fit in each account this one draws on.

rules.summary: Each block, for an account whose pending obligations exceed its balance, cancel its New entries newest first until the rest fit. Submitted entries count but are not cancelled.

refs.quote: For every account whose pending obligations exceed its current balance, cancels its `New` entries newest first until the rest fit. `Submitted` entries count but are left alone - they are already with the execution client.

refs.section: Keyed nonces and recent roots > Mempool rules > Balances
refs.quote: Checked at admission, and every block (newest entries are dropped first when a balance falls).

rules.summary: Each newly observed block, New entries are re-simulated against the new head and cancelled if no longer compliant.

refs.quote: Revalidation for `New` entries against newly mined state - entries admitted when compliant can stop being compliant as other transactions land
